name: メモ自動連携
oneline: メモにタグとリンクを付け、日・週・年でまとめる
usage: Desk の「メモ連携」で「今すぐ連携」を押す。毎時の同期でも動く。コマンドなら python3 lifeos/11-notes/cli.py run
04番が仕分けたアイデアと日記が入る。cli.py add "文" で手でも足せる
メモは Desk の「ノート」に1件ずつ出る。「関連メモ」のリンクを押すと次のメモが開く
毎日の要約、週の振り返り、年のまとめは briefs/ と Desk のノートの両方にできる
写真と手書きは notes/ に置く。文字は同じ名前の .txt に書く（自動の読み取りは未接続）
Cosense は範囲が決まるまで1ページも使わない
止めるときは cli.py stop。Desk から下げるときは cli.py unpublish
howToCheck: Desk のフォルダでターミナルを開く
python3 lifeos/11-notes/cli.py add "単語帳アプリを作りたい #語学" を実行する
python3 lifeos/11-notes/cli.py add "単語帳アプリの復習について調べた #語学" を実行する
Desk の「メモ連携」を開き、「今すぐ連携」を押す
メモの数が増えたことを見る
「ノートで見る」を押し、今日の日付の 📝 のメモを1つ開く
「関連メモ」のリンクを押し、もう1つのメモが開くことを見る
ノートの「📅 メモの要約」に今日の日付のものがあることを見る
試したメモが要らなければ、Desk の「削除」で消す

blockers.what: Cosense のメモの取り込み範囲
blockers.why: どこまで使うか決まっていないので、Cosense との対応付けは止めています。ほかの機能は動きます。
blockers.needs: 範囲を決める（全部・タグ・ページ名の先頭・更新日のどれか）。Cosense から書き出した JSON を desk/data/lifeos/tools/11-notes/cosense-export.json に置き、cli.py cosense-scope で範囲を指定する。手順は lifeos/11-notes/README.md にあります

blockers.what: 写真と手書きの文字の読み取り
blockers.why: 読み取る方法が決まっていないので、写真は文字なしのメモになります。関連メモも付きません。
blockers.needs: 方法を決めて伝える（Claude に読ませる、Mac の文字認識を使うなど）。決まるまでは、写真と同じ名前の .txt に文字を書けば動きます

_en.name: Auto-linked notes
_en.oneline: Adds tags and links to notes, and summarizes them by day, week and year
usage: Press "Link now" in "Note links" in the Desk. It also runs with the hourly sync. From the command line: python3 lifeos/11-notes/cli.py run
Ideas and diary entries sorted by No. 04 come in. You can add one by hand with cli.py add "text"
Each note appears in Desk "Notes". Press a "Related notes" link to open the next one
Daily summaries, weekly reviews and yearly roundups are made in both briefs/ and Desk notes
Put photos and handwriting in notes/. Write the text in a .txt with the same name (automatic reading is not connected yet)
Cosense is not used at all until its scope is decided
To stop it, run cli.py stop. To take notes off the Desk, run cli.py unpublish
howToCheck: Open Terminal in the Desk folder
Run python3 lifeos/11-notes/cli.py add "I want to build a flashcard app #languages"
Run python3 lifeos/11-notes/cli.py add "Looked into review timing for the flashcard app #languages"
Open "Note links" in the Desk and press "Link now"
Check that the note count went up
Press "View in Notes" and open one of today's 📝 notes
Press a "Related notes" link and check that the other note opens
Check that "📅 Note summary" in Notes has one for today
If you do not need the test notes, remove them with "Delete" in the Desk

blockers.what: Scope of Cosense notes to import
blockers.why: How much to use is not decided, so matching with Cosense is turned off. Everything else works.
blockers.needs: Decide the scope (all, by tag, by page-name prefix, or by update date). Put a JSON export from Cosense at desk/data/lifeos/tools/11-notes/cosense-export.json and set the scope with cli.py cosense-scope. Steps are in lifeos/11-notes/README.md

blockers.what: Reading text from photos and handwriting
blockers.why: The reading method is not decided, so photos become notes without text. They get no related notes either.
blockers.needs: Choose a method and say which (have Claude read them, use the Mac's text recognition, and so on). Until then, it works if you write the text in a .txt with the same name as the photo
